title: potentilla anserina f. aurantiaca
intro: Potentilla anserina f. aurantiaca, commonly known as Golden Cinquefoil, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the Rosaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting the immune system. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Golden Cinquefoil include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
